lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The flank displays approximately 8 to 10 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the branchial region. These blobs are arranged in a repeating geometric grid where the spacing between centroids increases along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of high-contrast nodes where the circular blobs are centered within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the superior aspect of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance pixels dorsally to shadowed lower-luminance pixels ventrally.
